skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Light Gold Celebration
skins.content: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Light Gold Celebration. Generalissimo Myrtle's attire during her triumphant return. Stand at attention–– and salute!
skins.quote: 'The celebration is about to begin~ Sound the horns, spread the confetti, and follow me!'

skins.name: Summer Flowers FA062
skins.content: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flowers Series FA062. Brings out a girl's figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer's hottest trend.
skins.quote: The great generalissimo has defeated the sun. Enjoy the triumph of the sea breeze before moving on to conquer the waves.

skins.name: Bustling Festival
skins.content: Taiko no Tatsujin Collaboration Outfit/Bustling Festival. Myrtle no longer cares about scoremaxxing during this grand festival, having fun drumming to the beat, rousing the audience's spirit. Don Don—KA!
skins.quote: That was the 10-star 'Clapolpolska' randomed from the song category! So? Did my skills amaze you?' Myrtle points at the screen, showing off her perfect full combo result to you.
